title: Parallelizing Graphviz Dot Layout Algorithm using OpenMP

contributions.purpose: 定位 GraphViz 布局的并行瓶颈
contributions.mechanism: perf 剖析+phase 级成本模型识别核心 kernel
contributions.domain: AI 驱动 HPC/图布局并行
contributions.source_quote: A function- and phase-level study of GraphViz identifying rank2(), transposes, rcross(), ncross(), and median computations as primary cost centers

contributions.purpose: 用 AI 集成自动生成 OpenMP 并行代码
contributions.mechanism: LLM 集成(Claude3.5/GPT-4o/Gemini1.5)按 kernel 访问模式插入 #pragma omp+reduction 并做验证
contributions.evaluation: ThreadSanitizer/Valgrind 零数据竞争,MD5 输出位相等
contributions.source_quote: OpenMP-based templates (loop decomposition, dependency-aware reductions, cache-friendly transposes) generated for the identified kernels
we demonstrate a peak speedup of 3.78× with 47.2% parallel efficiency across diverse graph topologies

self_declared_provenance.quote: This framework is adapted from [7] and extended with additional validation steps.
